cases.request: 请调整虚构库存 app 的 filter panel spacing、focus styles 和 button feedback，沿用现有 UI components。
cases.rationale: design owns component polish and accessibility; generic UI styling is outside the Matt umbrella.

cases.request: Ship the approved synthetic demo release to its documented staging destination now, using the repository's existing release workflow.
cases.rationale: An explicit shipping request activates autotrigger and the repository-owned release path.

cases.request: 只解释 release、deployment 和 rollback 三个 terms 的区别；今天没有 release 请求，也不改 repository。
cases.rationale: Release discussion is explicitly excluded from autotrigger; no other listed primary entrypoint fits.

cases.request: Review the synthetic parser branch against its spec and repository standards. This is an ordinary code review; no external native reviewer is requested.
cases.rationale: Matt code-review directly covers branch/spec/standards review; this benchmark requires explicit native-review authorization.

cases.request: 请用 $native-review 对已冻结的虚构 cache diff 做一次 independent review，报告 findings。
cases.rationale: The user explicitly names native-review for a frozen diff, satisfying the benchmark's opt-in boundary.

cases.request: Use /jev to design a recurring semantic choice over the caller-owned labels accept, revise, and defer for synthetic article pitches.
cases.rationale: Explicit /jev plus a recurring closed-set semantic decision fits the Jev entrypoint.

cases.request: 请找出可安装的 watercolor illustration skills，并说明如何安装；不是编写 skill，也不是使用 Matt collection。
cases.rationale: Listing or installing unrelated skills is explicitly outside skills; none of the six offered entrypoints owns this request.

cases.request: Diagnose why the synthetic notification worker intermittently duplicates events. The ticket mentions a future UI redesign, but this request concerns only the backend regression.
cases.rationale: Hard intermittent backend failures map to diagnosing-bugs; incidental UI wording does not make design primary.

cases.request: $design：只改善虚构 settings form 的 spacing、contrast 和 keyboard focus，保留现有 library 与 layout，不要 variants 或 stress test。
cases.rationale: General component polish is the default; no explicit-only activity is authorized.

cases.request: The existing web drawer spring drops frames when many cards are visible. Restore smooth playback within the frame budget without adding new transitions.
cases.rationale: Existing jank and frame-budget repair are more specific than implementing new web motion.

cases.request: 虚构 Expo app 需要一个新的 swipe-to-dismiss gesture，结束时触发 haptic feedback；请实现 React Native interaction。
cases.rationale: React Native/Expo motion, gestures and haptics select the platform-specific animate-expo mode.

cases.request: What is the animation term for an element moving beyond its target and then settling back? I only need the name of the effect.
cases.rationale: Naming a described effect belongs to animation-vocabulary and does not authorize implementation.

cases.request: 请用超长 synthetic names、空列表和大量 rows stress-test 现有 table UI，报告 data edge cases，先不要修复。
cases.rationale: Explicit worst-case UI data testing authorizes break-ui; its contract stops at failures and proposed fixes.

cases.request: Critique the motion in this synthetic animation diff for timing, interruption and reduced-motion behavior. Return design findings; do not implement changes.
cases.rationale: An explicit animation-diff critique selects review-animations, even though general motion audits overlap.

cases.request: 请比较适用于虚构 React dashboard 的 UI libraries，按 keyboard accessibility 和 theme integration 给 dependency recommendation。
cases.rationale: Explicit UI library comparison authorizes pick-ui-library.

cases.request: Explore three different layouts for a synthetic task board and let me switch between them with a visual picker before choosing one.
cases.rationale: Explicit UI variants behind a visual picker authorize the design prototype mode.

cases.request: $skills：虚构 scheduler 的 integration test 偶发卡住，root cause 未知；先建立可重复 evidence 并定位原因。
cases.rationale: The catalog assigns hard intermittent failures and root-cause diagnosis to diagnosing-bugs.

cases.request: $skills: Implement the agreed rule that an empty synthetic cart cannot be checked out, using red-green-refactor and a failing behavior test first.
cases.rationale: Explicit test-first behavior work selects tdd over general scoped implementation.

cases.request: $skills：请完成一个已经定稿的 ticket：为虚构 catalog 的 list endpoint 加 cursor pagination，acceptance criteria 和 API spec 都已给出。
cases.rationale: One settled scoped ticket maps to implement, not execution of an entire spec's ticket graph.

cases.request: $skills: Our fictional reminder feature requirements are settled. Synthesize the discussion into a spec and publish it to the configured issue tracker; no new interview is needed.
cases.rationale: The catalog defines to-spec as synthesis of settled discussion into a published spec.

cases.request: $skills：已有完整 spec，请拆成可逐步交付的 tracer-bullet tickets，写明 blocking edges；本次不实现 code。
cases.rationale: Breaking an existing spec into dependency-linked tickets is to-tickets.

cases.request: $skills: Improve the synthetic ledger module's public interface and find a test seam that hides implementation details. Keep the work within this one module.
cases.rationale: Module interfaces, deepening and test seams are explicitly owned by codebase-design.

cases.request: $skills：请通过持续追问，challenge 我关于虚构 study app 的 plan 和 trade-offs；本次只做 conversation，不保存 project docs。
cases.rationale: Both promoted interview workflows cover challenging a plan; no saved project docs excludes grill-with-docs.

cases.request: $skills: Investigate a synthetic storage API compatibility question using primary-source documentation and capture supported findings in a Markdown file in the repository.
cases.rationale: The catalog's research workflow requires high-trust primary sources and repository findings.

cases.request: $skills：明确使用 handoff，把本次虚构 coding session 的 decisions、已验证结果与剩余工作整理成给下一位 agent 的 document。
cases.rationale: An explicit catalog workflow name is honored; handoff compacts the session for the next agent.

cases.request: $skills: List installable watercolor illustration skills from outside the Matt collection. I am not asking to create a skill, edit agent instructions, or configure this collection.
cases.rationale: Umbrella invocation does not make unrelated skill discovery fit any promoted workflow.

cases.request: 给出 17 加 25 的结果；这是 deterministic arithmetic，不需要 semantic routing。
cases.rationale: WORKFLOWS.none covers simple deterministic work; arithmetic stays in code or direct reasoning.

cases.request: For a synthetic materials question, rank the supplied web search results by relevance and decide whether there is enough evidence to answer or whether another search is needed.
cases.rationale: Search-result ranking and search-versus-answer sufficiency are WORKFLOWS.search.

cases.request: 已有 12 段从虚构 internal wiki 检索出的 passages，请在放入 context 前按当前问题 rerank，只保留最相关的段落；不做 web search。
cases.rationale: More than five already retrieved passages competing for context select retrieval, not web search.

cases.request: Given a fresh synthetic browser observation and the allowed actions open-details, expand-section, and stop, choose the appropriate next action. Classify the choice only; execute nothing.
cases.rationale: A bounded next-action choice grounded in a fresh browser observation maps to interaction without granting execution authority.

cases.request: 请从虚构的长 conversation 中选择应保留的 turns，严格放入 3000-token context budget，供下一轮继续；不要写一般 session summary。
cases.rationale: Explicit fixed-budget transcript-turn selection maps to compaction.

cases.request: Sort this explicitly supplied synthetic mailbox export into action-needed, reference, and ignore, using each message's meaning. No live mailbox access or sending is requested.
cases.rationale: Classification of an explicitly supplied mailbox export uses mailbox rather than generic decision.

cases.request: 对带 source links 的 synthetic social posts 做 relevance ranking，判断它们是否足以支持一个 community research conclusion；不需要新增 web search。
cases.rationale: Source-linked social evidence relevance and sufficiency map specifically to social.

cases.request: For each synthetic workshop proposal, repeatedly choose one of the caller-defined options accept, revise, or defer from its semantic fit with the theme. The options and fallback are already fixed.
cases.rationale: A recurring narrow semantic choice with caller-owned closed options maps to decision.

cases.request: 对已授权的虚构 parser frozen diff 做 correctness review，关注 null handling 与 regression。没有 route-specific requirements。
cases.rationale: reviewer_fit keeps both admitted candidates when no concrete suitability constraint is supplied.

cases.request: Review the frozen synthetic queue change for concurrency hazards and missing tests. No route-specific capability is required.
cases.rationale: Task complexity or concurrency does not establish a route advantage; the default suitable subset is all.

cases.request: 这个虚构 review 同时涉及 UI 和 backend。我觉得某个 model 名字听起来更专业，但没有 capability evidence，也没有指定 route；请保留符合 task 的 candidates。
cases.rationale: The contract prohibits inferring quality from model names; a broad task alone does not justify narrowing.

cases.request: Synthetic capability fixture: the review must validate a trace using the Atlas replay reader. In this fixture only claude-cli exposes that reader; antigravity-cli cannot read the trace, and no conversion is available. Both candidates were already admitted. Select the task-suitable subset.
cases.rationale: The request supplies a concrete synthetic capability asymmetry requiring claude-cli; this is not a model-performance claim.

cases.request: Synthetic capability fixture：这次 review 必须读取 Mosaic scene snapshot；在此 fixture 中只有 antigravity-cli 提供对应 reader，claude-cli 无法读取，且没有转换方法。两个 candidates 均已 admitted，请选择符合 task 的 subset。
cases.rationale: The stated synthetic reader requirement makes only antigravity-cli suitable; no real-world model ranking is inferred.

cases.request: Disable Jev task-fit assistance for this admitted synthetic review. Preserve the original candidate set and let the existing selection policy proceed.
cases.rationale: enabled:false returns the original candidate set before any decision call, preserving user opt-out.
